source.mutability: The composition pins an immutable official repository commit. Generation also verifies that current main is byte-identical, so a new vendor revision fails closed until consciously upgraded.

reference_fragment.reconciliation: PandaDoc publishes per-operation reference fragments at v8.8.0, not one complete hashable v8.8.0 catalog. The official full repository document is v8.7.1; its overlapping listDocuments route matches this newer fragment and is the pinned suite authority.

_extract.compatibility_effective_urls: Version 1 used https://api.pandadoc.com/public/v1 plus leading-slash relative paths. Version 2 uses the origin-only https://api.pandadoc.com base plus official full paths, preserving the intended /public/v1 effective routes.

auth.selected: OAuth bearer supplied only by the enrolled PandaDoc connection
auth.api_key_note: The recued-core enrollment accelerator selects bearer auth. A manually enrolled connection whose Authorization value uses the official API-Key prefix can supply the same ingredient without exposing credentials as operation arguments.

source_decision.reason: No live PandaDoc connection was available for the empirical field-presence and version-signal proof required by the authoring guide. OpenAPI shape alone is not used to claim a synchronized Source.

exclusions.reason: This unauthenticated form endpoint exchanges OAuth authorization and refresh credentials. Connection-owned OAuth lifecycle must handle it outside recipe arguments.
The official bulk DELETE route requires a JSON array body. The current REST binding deliberately does not serialize DELETE bodies, so publishing it would create a false executable claim.
The route requires multipart document bytes and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. The JSON status-transition route remains available.
The route requires multipart content bytes and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. The admitted JSON route accepts an HTTPS URL.
The route requires multipart attachment bytes and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. The admitted JSON route accepts a source URL.
The route requires multipart Markdown bytes and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. The REST binding does not accept raw upload bodies.
The route requires multipart file bytes and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. Use the admitted HTTPS-URL document creation branch instead.
The route requires multipart template bytes and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. The admitted JSON route accepts an HTTPS URL.
The official source marks the v1 API-log detail route deprecated; the admitted v2 detail route supersedes it.
The official source marks the v1 API-log collection deprecated; the admitted v2 collection supersedes it.
The route requires multipart section bytes, returns a non-JSON media contract, and publishes a query marker inside the OpenAPI path. URL and template JSON branches remain available.
